title: Forbidden Awakening
next_chapter_hook: Su Qingyao's blood dyed half her garment crimson. With the last ounce of her strength, she turned her gaze toward Chen Ji—three years of pursuit, three years of protection, and at this moment, she finally had her answer.

text.content: The heavens tore apart abruptly. A beam of ink-black light erupted from Han Lie, the Sect Master of the Xuanwu Sect. The aura contained within that light was ancient and terrifying, as if a ferocious beast that had slumbered for ten thousand years had finally opened its eyes. The spiritual energy between heaven and earth surged wildly at this moment, forming visible vortices that dyed the sky for a hundred miles into a chaotic mess.

Chen Ji stood atop a distant mountain peak. The wind stirred his robes but could not move the deep cold intent in his eyes. The Tianji Record fragment in his embrace radiated gentle warmth—a warning of danger. Every degree of heat spoke of the impending catastrophe. "Beyond half a step of Transcendence..." he murmured, yet a mocking arc curved at the corner of his lips. "Old thing, do you think this is your trump card?"

Han Lie's roar shook the heavens: "Chen Ji! You forced me to动用禁忌之力, today I shall let you witness what true Xuanwu bloodline power truly is!" His form swelled to three zhang in height, surrounded by jet-black scales. Each scale bore ancient inscriptions that radiated an suffocating pressure. It was a forbidden technique of the ancient Xuanwu tribe—trading one's lifespan and bloodline as the price for momentary power beyond one's realm.

dialogue.content: "Forced you?" Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "Sect Master Han, are you certain you aren't seeking your own death?" His fingers gently brushed the cover of the Tianji Record, sensing the power flowing within. This forbidden power was indeed terrifying, but he saw more—he saw the tottering seal within Han Lie's body, the counterattacking source power, the true outcome of this gamble.

text.content: The vanguard of the imperial dynasty's reinforcements was marching urgently toward the battlefield. It was a vanguard force of three thousand elite cultivators, commanded by Zhao Wuya, Commander of the Imperial Guards. They had rushed here without rest upon receiving news, yet they did not know death had already descended from the heavens. Han Lie's gaze swept toward that unit, a savage smile appearing at the corner of his lips: "Since you dare meddle in Xuanwu Sect's affairs, let me show you what is called—Forbidden!"

A pillar of jet-black light erupted from Han Lie's palm toward the heavens. The power contained within that pillar caused heaven and earth to tremble. The moment it descended, the three thousand cultivators of the imperial vanguard didn't even have time to scream before being reduced to dust in an instant. Blood mist filled the air, dyeing half the sky crimson. Countless storage bags and magical artifacts lay scattered across the ground, yet no one dared to pick them up. Chen Ji, standing in the distance, sensed that tremendous threat and his heart sank—his chess game had been completely disrupted by this sudden forbidden power.

Atop the mountain peak, Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes. The Tianji Record fragment projected a blurry scene into his mind—three hours into the future, Su Qingyao drenched in blood shielding him, while she herself... "Impossible." His eyes snapped open, an unprecedented cold gleam flickering in his pupils. "This game has not yet reached the point of no return."

At that moment, a white-robed figure like a startled swan skimmed across the battlefield. Su Qingyao had somehow infiltrated to the slope below the mountain peak where Chen Ji stood. Her expression was icy as frost, yet the fire of determination burned in her eyes. When she saw that world-destroying forbidden light spreading toward Chen Ji's location, she hesitated not at all—her form transformed into a white流光, directly crashing into that terrifying pillar of light.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, did you think I would let you die here?" Su Qingyao's voice echoed through the storm. "Three years. You've hidden deep enough, but you've forgotten one thing—" Her arms spread wide as the Tianqing Sect's supreme heart technique "Tianxuan Art" operated at full power. A brilliant azure barrier materialized before her, forcibly halting the erosion of the forbidden power. "—You were never alone!"

text.content: The moment the forbidden power collided with the Tianxuan Art, a tremendous shockwave spread in all directions. Rocks shattered, trees turned to ash. Su Qingyao's face instantly became deathly pale, blood seeped from her seven apertures, yet she clenched her teeth and did not retreat a single step. A phantom azure lotus appeared around her—that was the hallmark of the ninth level of Tianxuan Art: using one's own essence blood as a guide to forcibly elevate one cultivation stage. She was using her own life to buy Chen Ji precious time.

Chen Ji froze. He stared at that blood-stained yet still standing figure, and somewhere in his heart felt as if something had struck it hard. Flashes of the past three years flooded through his mind—her countless probes, her countless approaches, her countless appearances at critical moments. He had always believed she was investigating his secrets, never once considering...

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao!" Chen Ji's voice was no longer calm. It was the eruption of emotions he had suppressed for three years. "You fool! Who told you to come die!" His form surged upward, the power of the Tianji Record surged wildly within his body, yet his cultivation still seemed so insignificant before that forbidden power.

text.content: Su Qingyao turned her head, a strand of blood trickling from her lips, yet a relieved smile appeared on her face: "Chen Ji, you finally call me by name." Her voice was weak yet clear. "Three years... I chased you for three years... Do you know why?" The forbidden power was wildly eroding her defenses, cracks were appearing in the azure lotus phantom, yet she still did not retreat a single step.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao is about to be reduced to ashes by the forbidden power. Chen Ji must make a choice—expose the true power of the Tianji Record, or seek another way?

choices.text: Burning Heavenly Fate to reverse the battlefield
choices.description: Forcibly use the Tianji Record to foresee key moments in the next three hours, consuming 50 points of Heavenly Fate in exchange for one counterattack opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Reverse the erosion of forbidden power, counter-kill Han Lie
choices.risk_hint: Massive consumption of Heavenly Fate will cause the inevitable backlash to arrive early

text.content: The Tianji Record fragment burned in Chen Ji's palm, golden light bursting forth from between the characters—that was its complete form he had never displayed before. The power of foresight rushed into his consciousness like a tide. He found the flaw in the forbidden power—the core of Han Lie's tottering seal. "Found it." He murmured, cold light flickering in his eyes.

dialogue.content: "Han Lie, did you think the forbidden power was your own?" Chen Ji's voice rang out through the storm, carrying incomparable mockery. "That is merely a piece on Heaven's chessboard. And I happen to know how to make this piece turn against its master!" He flicked his finger, and a beam of golden light pierced through the forbidden power, directly striking Han Lie's seal core.

choices.description: Through secret transmission contact the secretly observing old Sect Master, making him believe this is an opportunity to control Chen Ji and strike
choices.visible_cost: Expose the connection with Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Kill two birds with one stone, let Ling Yuan and Han Lie weaken each other
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may take the opportunity to create a greater threat

text.content: A secret transmission pierced through the storm and reached a pair of profound eyes within distant clouds. Ling Yuan slowly opened his eyes. A knowing smile appeared on his aged face. "Interesting. This kid finally comes to beg me?" His form slowly emerged from the clouds, drifting toward the battlefield.

dialogue.content: "Han Lie, you used the forbidden power at a bad time." Ling Yuan's voice rang like a great bell, an even more terrifying aura erupting from his body. "The affairs of the Tianqing Sect do not concern you." He flicked his sleeve, a brilliant sword light chopped toward the intersection point of the forbidden power and Su Qingyao.

choices.text: Use Demonic Path mist to cover retreat
choices.description: Activate the Demonic Path mist left by Ye Qing, temporarily conceal the Tianji Record's aura, retreat with Su Qingyao to a safe zone
choices.visible_cost: Lose this opportunity to strike Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Su Qingyao's life, wait for a better opportunity
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie will escape, exacerbating contradictions between the Imperial Dynasty and Xuanwu Sect

text.content: Chen Ji took out a pitch-black jade talisman from his embrace. It was a life-saving item left by Ye Qing before parting. "Forgive me, Senior Sister Su." He murmured softly. He pulled the nearly exhausted Su Qingyao into his embrace while crushing the jade talisman. Dense demonic energy surged forth from the talisman, instantly shrouding the entire mountain peak.

dialogue.content: "Go!" Chen Ji low shouted. His form carried Su Qingyao into the demonic mist. When Han Lie's forbidden power thundered down, it only shattered empty space. Where were there any figures? Han Lie howled in rage yet was helpless. The Demonic Path mist not only concealed their aura but also disrupted all tracking techniques.

text.content: The moment Chen Ji made his choice, another strange phenomenon occurred in the heavens. An even more ancient aura descended from the depths of the sky. That was a terrifying existence beyond all realms—the gaze of the Heavenly Eye. It seemed to mock this struggle between ants, yet also seemed to be plotting something greater. Chen Ji's heart trembled. He felt those无形 eyes fixed on him, fixed on the Tianji Record in his hand.

No matter what choice Chen Ji made, the situation had already completely spun out of control. The awakening of the forbidden power not only shattered the battlefield's balance but also attracted the attention of Heaven's will. Chen Ji's meticulously crafted chess game had been fragmented by these突如其来的 variables, and he had to quickly rearrange—no, because beside him still stood a woman who protected him with her life.

When the dust settled, Han Lie's howls echoed across the empty battlefield. His swelled three-zhang form was slowly shrinking. The backlash of the forbidden power was beginning to manifest—jet-black scales crumbled one by one, blood seeped from every pore on his body. Yet his eyes still burned with mad hatred as he stared fixedly in the direction Chen Ji had disappeared. "Chen Ji... did you think you could escape?" His voice was hoarse like a ghost's. "The forbidden power has awakened. This war... has only just begun!"

In a cave dozens of miles away, Chen Ji gently laid down the unconscious Su Qingyao. Her face was pale as paper, her breathing weak to the point of being barely perceptible, yet a faint smile lingered at the corner of her lips. Chen Ji was silent for a long moment, then finally reached out, gently brushing away the bloodstains on her forehead. "Three years... so you had been protecting me all along." His voice was low, carrying unprecedented warmth. "Su Qingyao, rest assured. What Chen Ji owes you, I shall repay a hundredfold."

dialogue.content: He stood up, his gaze penetrating the cave toward the distant horizon. The Tianji Record fragment in his embrace radiated gentle warmth—that was proof of the Heavenly Eye's gaze. Chen Ji coldly laughed, whispering: "Heavenly Eye... so you've finally shown yourself?" He placed Su Qingyao in a safe position and set up concealment formations around her. "Wait for my return." His figure disappeared into the depths of the cave, leaving only a whisper-thin promise.

text.content: Meanwhile, the main force of the imperial dynasty's reinforcements finally arrived at the battlefield. When they saw the dust remains of the vanguard and the scattered artifact fragments, the entire army fell into deathly silence. The Deputy Commander of the Imperial Guards' eyes burned with roaring fury: "Xuanwu Sect! What a fine Xuanwu Sect!" Through gritted teeth, he gave the order: "Report to His Majesty immediately. The blood debt of three thousand sons must be repaid in blood!"

In the Tianqing Sect's Council Hall, Ling Yuan sat upright in the main seat. No emotion could be seen on his aged face. When the news arrived, he merely nodded slightly, a profound gleam flickering in his eyes. "The forbidden power has awakened..." he murmured to himself, his withered fingers tapping lightly on the armrest. "Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, what are you plotting? Let this old man see, what tricks can this little fox still play." A strange smile curved at the corner of his lips, as if everything was under his control.
